(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<80;i++){ if(window.__app && __app.player.video.readyState>=2) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } __app.showTab('player'); return 'ms title: ' + navigator.mediaSession.metadata?.title + ' · state ' + navigator.mediaSession.playbackState; })()

(async()=>{ document.querySelector('.lib-tools input[type=search]')?.focus(); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'k',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const inp=document.querySelector('.palette-input'); if(!inp) return 'palette did not open'; inp.value='subt'; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const first=[...document.querySelectorAll('.palette-item')].map(b=>b.innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(' ')).slice(0,4); inp.value='lib'; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); const lib=[...document.querySelectorAll('.palette-item')].map(b=>b.innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10))[0]).slice(0,3); return 'subt -> ' + first.join(' / ') + ' || lib -> ' + lib.join(' / '); })()

(async()=>{ const inp=document.querySelector('.palette-input'); inp.value='go to settings'; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); inp.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return 'palette closed: ' + !document.querySelector('.palette-input') + ', settings page visible: ' + (document.querySelector('.page[data-page=settings]')?.offsetParent !== null); })()

(async()=>{ __app.showTab('player'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); document.activeElement?.blur(); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'?',shiftKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const m=[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal')].pop(); const t=m?.querySelector('h3')?.textContent + ' · ' + m?.querySelectorAll('.sc-row').length + ' rows'; return t; })()

(async()=>{ document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); const th=await import('./themes.js'); th.setTheme('auto'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const dark=matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches; const attr=document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme'); th.setTheme('midnight'); return 'Windows prefers dark: ' + dark + ' -> theme attribute ' + attr + ' (light expected when not dark, none when dark)'; })()
(async()=>{ const v=__app.player.video; v.pause(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); return 'playback state after pause: ' + navigator.mediaSession.playbackState; })()
